rubric.grounded: 0=wrong entity/time/fact or unsupported physical/causal claim;1=all claims supported or explicitly qualified.
rubric.pattern: 0=only narrates an event/stat;1=connects evidence into the expected meaningful pattern, or appropriately abstains in the quiet case.
rubric.consequence: 0=no supported significance;1=explains relevance to score, opportunity, progression or player contribution.
rubric.alternative: 0=missing/canned/unsupported counterstory;1=plausible bounded alternative or uncertainty tied to this evidence.
rubric.watch_next: 0=vague/forecast/order;1=specific observable next check linked to the pattern.
rubric.audience: 0=wrong language, unreadable or ignores player focus;1=appropriate language/depth/focus.
